tasks.title: Authenticated clients can identify their token through GET /admin/tokens/self
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, Behavior (Required behavior section 1), all Checks and Completion evidence; Counterexamples /self before :id, no actions, auth and overlap; Performance impact api/test_cpu_s; Security impact for the new admin route; Acceptance evidence 1. Keep parser, route label, dispatch, real-server regression tests and route documentation together. Use the optional token-routes.test.ts for literal parser and metrics/auth-label cases.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail after implementation; the new authenticated GET /admin/tokens/self case was first observed red on the base (404 rather than literal 200). Metadata passes validateTokenMetadata and matches the token created by the separate POST, lastUsedAt is non-null, and secret/digest keys are absent. Both overlap secrets identify the same id; statuses 401, 403 (probe and read-only), 404 (before import and self action paths), 405 with Allow: GET, and 429 retain the auth/throttle order and no-store header. Parser/route-label assertions distinguish exactly /admin/tokens/self from /admin/tokens/:id. Focused-suite coverage exit status is not the gate.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and full tests pass with line coverage at least 80%.

exit 0 on the base before implementation and on the completed change; record both measured test_cpu_s values against the independent 5.6 s budget named in Performance impact, without inventing a timing result or requiring the full bench A/B.

With an admin import and local test configuration, the service starts; the documented curl request to /admin/tokens/self returns literal 200 and metadata keys only. Record the curl command with variable references and status/key names, never the token or response body.

The PR records the red-first /self failure, check results, before/after test_cpu_s and live curl evidence. Its security checklist cites tests/commands for metadata-only responses, unchanged throttle/auth/status order, the 4096-byte token body limit, validated responses and unchanged dependency pins. REST route/scopes/token/status tables and operation rotation guidance describe /self.
